subject: Procurement & Security kickoff — vendor onboarding call
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lara Schmidt <lara.schmidt@starlitinc.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@starlitinc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement & Security kickoff — vendor onboarding call

Hi Lara / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we’d like to run a short vendor onboarding + procurement kickoff to align on contractual timelines, security evidence, and the technical demo scope so procurement and engineering have the same expectations. Goal: a single 45–60 minute call where procurement covers milestones (PO, SOW, licensing), security asks for evidence (SOC2 reports, data residency, retention), and SE walks through a hands-on demo of the integration flow.

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- Introductions (Redwood AE + SE, Starlit procurement + engineering)
- Procurement milestones & target dates
- Security requirements & evidence owners
- Demo: integration points, latency/throughput profile, keys/ops
- Next steps / mutual action plan / owners

Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_Playbook_v1.pdf (procurement checklist / typical timelines). I’ve also attached our standard onboarding checklist so procurement can see the typical deliverables.

Availability: can you share 45–60 minute windows over the next week? Our immediate availability is: Tue Apr 27 10:00–11:30 PT, Wed Apr 28 09:00–12:00 PT, or Thu Apr 29 13:00–16:00 PT. If those don’t work, suggest 2–3 alternatives and we’ll coordinate.

Ben (SE) — please come prepared to show the integration patterns and a short demo of token/cost controls. Olga — please standby for any security deep-dive questions.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Lara Schmidt <lara.schmidt@starlitinc.com>

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — this looks great. Procurement and security should be on the call. I attached our procurement-intake-form.xlsx so you can see the fields our vendor team needs filled (PO cadence, billing entity, contact emails, insurance).

Our team’s availability next week:
- Tue Apr 27: 09:30–10:30 PT (tight)
- Wed Apr 28: 10:00–11:30 PT (preferred)
- Thu Apr 29: Afternoon after 14:00 PT (can do 14:00–15:00)

If you can do Wed 10:00–11:00 PT that would be ideal — Rajiv will join for the demo and our security lead (security@starlitinc.com) will join for the evidence conversation. Can you also send the SOW / standard onboarding deliverable list so procurement can pre-populate questions?

Cheers,
Lara Schmidt
Procurement Manager | Starlit Inc.

Perfect — Wed Apr 28 10:00–11:00 PT is confirmed tentatively in my calendar. I’ll send a formal invite once Ben confirms the demo run order.

Quick notes:
- I’ll bring the SOW / onboarding deliverables (short SOW + mutual action plan) and upload a draft to the HubSpot deal link for your procurement team to review before the call.
- Olga (security) will have SOC2 and data residency answers ready; we can follow up with any additional evidence links after the call.
- Ben: can you confirm a 20–25 minute demo that highlights the integration path, latency numbers for a 1k token call, and how key rotation / KMS integration looks? Also call out any required scopes/roles for the initial POC.

Attachments (for procurement review): Redwood_Procurement_Playbook_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik
